_about: The default worst price on a Market order (D15, ARCHITECTURE.md section 3, computed by scripts/arch/cap.mjs on USERS.md's books). The price of the last book level needed to fill the whole quantity, moved 1 cent against the trader, kept within 1 to 99. A book is [priceCents, quantity] levels, best first. Buy Yes and Sell No walk the asks; Sell Yes and Buy No walk the bids. worstYesCents is the Yes price the program is given; traderCents is the price the ticket shows (Buy No and Sell No show the No price, 100 minus the Yes price); totalCents is traderCents times the quantity, the most a buyer pays or the least a seller receives (D84 shows it in USDC). null means the book cannot fill the quantity and the ticket offers a limit order instead. A frozen golden file: changing it is a logged decision.

cases.about: USERS F4: pay at most 66c, 6.60 in all
USERS F5: sells Yes at no less than 64c, so No costs at most 36c, 3.60 in all
USERS F7: receives at least 79c each, 7.90 in all
USERS F7: buys Yes at no more than 81c, so receives at least 19c per No, 1.90 in all
only the first level is needed: 65 plus 1
an empty side cannot fill anything

clampCases.about: a buy never goes above 99c (cap.mjs: min(p+1, 99))
a sell never goes below 1c (cap.mjs: max(p-1, 1))
